prologue_call.text: Mum, it's me. I'm almost at Papa's village... The GPS lost the signal an hour ago. It's just red dirt and palm trees now. I'll call you when I get th— what is that?!

prologue_flat.text: No signal... and now a flat. Perfect. Just perfect.

trunk.text: The spare is flat too... I'll take the tire iron. And this mirror is hanging off anyway. There are lights up the road.

road_call.text: Hello? Sir? Excuse me, do you know where I can find a mechanic?

road_gone.text: ...Where did he go? He was right there.

ayaba_appear.text: Don't read them out loud. They can hear you.

ayaba_1.text: You are looking for Kossi. Everybody who arrives here is looking for Kossi. Come. And don't talk to the others.

ayaba_mirror.text: Mama Dossi gave you food? Take your car mirror. Turn your back to her. Look at her in the glass.

ayaba_know.text: Now you know. Some of them are not... here anymore. Don't be afraid of me. Look at me too, if you want.

ayaba_owl.text: The owl belongs to the chief. When it screams, you hide. Always.

ayaba_grandpa.text: My grandfather was the healer. He had a calabash full of white powder. He said it keeps the fire asleep.

ayaba_station.text: Don't go to the station after midnight. That's when they remember.

kossi_1.text: A flat? I can fix it. But I need an inner tube, a patch kit, and power for my compressor. Go. And don't stay out after midnight.

kossi_story.text: Ten years ago tonight, there was a fête. The chief had cut the sacred iroko to store kpayo, smuggled petrol, hundreds of barrels. I sold him my tyres to roll them. When the fire came... I was the only one who ran fast enough.

kossi_nag.text: Bring me what I asked. And don't eat anything they give you.

kossi_act1.text: Good. Now power. The generator at the old station still works... I won't go back there. Take my machete. Here, we don't count the dead anymore. We count the living. Two. You... and me.

kossi_repaired.text: There. Your tyre will hold. Your car is ready. Leave before dawn... or... No. Just leave.

kossi_mad.text: Are you MAD?! I am the only one here still breathing, and you hit me?

dossi_1.text: Sit, my child. Eat some akassa. You must be so hungry... Kossi's patch kit? Yes, yes. First, you eat.

dossi_ate.text: Good... good. Now you will stay a little longer. Here. Your little box.

dossi_refuse.text: ...As you like. Take what you came for. Nobody refuses Mama Dossi twice.

dossi_stare.text: Why do you look at me like that? Eat, eat.

dossi_know.text: You looked in your little glass, eh? Then you know why nobody leaves.

happy_tube.text: An inner tube. Old, but it should hold.

happy_ate.text: It tasted... cold. Like it was cooked a long time ago.

happy_patch.text: A patch kit. Rusty, but complete.

happy_mirror_dossi.text: Her face... In the mirror, her face is burned.

happy_mirror_ayaba.text: She's... wet. Soaked. Like she just came out of the lagoon. But she's not burned.

happy_battery.text: The battery is still charged. Ten years in the ashes... and it's still charged.

happy_flash_dead.text: No... the flash just died. I need to charge my phone in the car. The hazard lights. Follow the hazard lights.

happy_flash_low.text: Battery's too low for the flash. The car. I have to charge it in the car.

happy_wake.text: I'm still here... I'm still here.

happy_plaza.text: Why are they all looking at me?

radio_news.text: ...and tonight we remember. Ten years ago, in the village of Azé-tin, an illegal fuel depot exploded during a festival. Sixty-three people died, among them the village chief, Houngbo, and the healer, Dah Agossou. The village was never... the village was never buried.

kossi_machete_ask.text: Take it. And this key... it opens the healer's house. I never had the courage to go back in.

kossi_machete_took.text: ...You didn't even ask. In this village, that is how it started. People taking.

happy_hornbill.text: That's not the owl. Deeper. Two notes... like it's calling me.

ayaba_stump.text: This was Loko. The oldest tree. Grandpa said it held the sky above the village. They cut it for the barrels.

agossou_stump.text: A living one... can finish what I began. My calabash waits in my house, by the water. Take the white earth. The burnt ones still fear it.

agossou_calabash.text: Kaolin. Throw it, and they remember that they are dead. Fill it again at my asen. Now go read the ashes. The truth is at the station.

agossou_tape.text: Without Loko, the fire will have no roof! Houngbo, you are selling our ancestors for a few barrels of petrol!

agossou_flash.text: Ayaba! Run! To the water! Don't look back!

agossou_plants.text: Three plants for three verses. The moon liana, the ash grass, the hornbill flower. With them, the dead can go home.

happy_frag_photo.text: A photo. Men with chainsaws around a huge tree... and the chief in the middle, smiling.

happy_frag_notebook.text: His debt book. Every page in red. The last one says: paid in full... by the barrels.

happy_frag_register.text: A register. Three hundred barrels. Delivered the week of the festival.

happy_frag_drawing.text: A child's drawing. The tree, the houses... and a big black owl sitting on the chief's roof.

happy_frag_tape.text: A cassette. There's still a walkman in my bag... let's hear it.

happy_plant.text: This plant... it's glowing. Like it was waiting for someone.

ayaba_flash_end.text: He pushed me into the lagoon. The fire couldn't follow me there. ...But I never came out of the water either.

flash_party.text: It's the festival! Everyone is here. The chief bought drinks for the whole village tonight.

houngbo_offer.text: Welcome, traveller. That old fool cursed my village. Burn what is left of his house... and I will let you leave. You have my word.

happy_crown.text: In the mirror... his crown is made of ash.

kossi_after.text: You met him. I can see it on your face. Give me the battery. Your car will be ready. Then... you choose.
